text.en: Inner monologue is row 64 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Inner monologue 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 64 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates Inner monologue with “Inner monologue: Embodied reasoning through planning with language models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Inner monologue 与论文《Inner monologue: Embodied reasoning through planning with language models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Wenlong Huang, Fei Xia, Ted Xiao”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Wenlong Huang（官方页拼写）、Fei Xia（官方页拼写）、Ted Xiao（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Wenlong Huang, Fei Xia, Ted Xiao”。
